findings.title: S2-F2 remains open: CI accepts a zero-gate invocation
findings.body: `readWorkflowInvocations` accepts any inline `run:` value containing `bun run gate:ci`, rather than requiring the canonical command. Therefore `run: bun run gate:ci --check-only` passes parity; Bun forwards the flag, and the runner's check-only branch exits 0 without executing selected gates (`scripts/run-gates.mjs:427-430`). The same parser accepts `|| true`, which masks gate failures. Ticket 08 can consequently install permanently green CI that runs none of the nine-ticket gate graph.
findings.recommendation: Accept only the exact normalized workflow scalar `bun run gate:ci` and exact package script `node scripts/run-gates.mjs --ci`, rejecting suffix arguments and shell operators. Add public-process fixtures for `--check-only`, `--help`, and `|| true`.

next_steps: Tighten the CI command shapes and rerun the runner suite plus the zero-gate counterexample.
